source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Why your tip “isn’t working.”
Tips in our app are a separate USDC transfer transaction from your wallet to founderWallet after mint. If you cancel that second tip transaction, the mint still succeeds (exactly what you observed), but the tip won’t be sent.
Also, right now the “auto” follow-up behavior is confusing: for no-referral mints, there can be a different “Step 2” tx (finalize random referral), which also can pop up.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that a tip is implemented as a separate post-mint USDC transfer from the buyer to the founder wallet, and canceling that transaction prevents the tip without canceling the mint.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
okay, i just minted with 'no referral code' and a '$1 tip'.

I had to execute 1 transaction to mint - 0xc92e17e9e7f26e6b4e03093ce35f6ed3d7fc135c8ee00bc77357eb082779f715

And then another transaction immediately appeared for the tip - 0x887c21856bddc283cd444881931a1d14469cbbd49c2c2764e15855a9181af3b0

(We will have to put a UI note so that buyers know the tip transaction will come immediately after the mint transaction.)

Also, Perhaps it was hidden behind the tip transaction, but i didn't see the 'mint successful' modal.

And, on the leaderboard, there was no new commission and ticket counted.

value_updates.tip_transaction_timing: separate transaction immediately after the mint transaction
value_updates.tip_transaction_disclosure: Inform buyers that the selected tip requires an immediate second transaction after minting.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
One more important note from your case
Your “$1 tip” tx ended up as a self-transfer because the on-chain founderWallet is currently your wallet, so tipping yourself doesn’t move funds. I deployed a UI safeguard to disable tips in that case.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports deploying a UI safeguard that disables tipping when the connected buyer wallet is also the founder wallet.
